data.name: Rafaat
data.gender_notes: Rafaat is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who heals and bestows good fortune. The name Rafaat carries the meaning “Healer, Giver of Good Fortune” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rafaat usually hope their child will grow to embody healer, giver of good fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who seek healing and blessing in their lives, often associated with acts of kindness and generosity
data.etymology: Rafaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Healer, Giver of Good Fortune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rafaat total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_urdu.name: رفاع
in_urdu.meaning: مرتفع، بلند، اُٹھا، بلند مرتبه کا
in_urdu.long_meaning: رفاع کا مطلب ہے بلند، اونچا، اُٹھا، بلند مرتبہ کا، اور یہ نام اسلامی ناموں میں ایک شاندار نام ہے۔ اس نام کے معنی سے پتہ چلتا ہے کہ ہر مسلمان کے لیے بلند مرتبہ کا مقصد ہے۔ اس کے معنی سے ہم یہ بھی سمجھتے ہیں کہ ہم اپنی زندگی میں بلند اور بلند مرتبہ کا راستہ اختیار کریں۔ اسلامی ناموں میں ہم اس نام کو خاص اہمیت دیتے ہیں کیونکہ یہ نام ہم کو بلندو بالا ہونے کی تلقین کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रफ़ाय
in_hindi.long_meaning: रफ़ाय नाम का अर्थ है उच्च, ऊँचा, ऊँची, और यह नाम इस्लामिक नामों में एक शानदार नाम है। इसके अर्थ से पता चलता है कि हर मुसलमान के लिए उच्च और ऊँचा दर्जा होना है। इसके अर्थ से हम यह भी समझते हैं कि हम अपने जीवन में उच्च और ऊँचा दर्जा प्राप्त करने का रास्ता अपनाएं। इस्लामिक नामों में हम इस नाम को विशेष महत्व देते हैं क्योंकि यह नाम हमें उच्च और ऊँचा होने की प्रेरणा देता है।

in_english.long_meaning: The one who heals and bestows good fortune

data.cultural_impact: The name Rafaat holds great cultural significance in the Islamic world, reflecting the hope and belief in divine mercy, healing, and favor. It is often considered a name for boys that parents believe will bestow good fortune upon their child, much like the names Khair (meaning good), Salah (meaning prayer), and Siddiq (meaning truthful). The cultural significance of the name reinforces the idea of seeking protection and guidance from Allah (God) and is a reminder of the promise of spiritual healing and growth for those who remain steadfast in their faith.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Rafaat holds tremendous spiritual significance, signifying the promise of healing and blessings from Allah. In faith, it is believed that Allah grants mercy, forgiveness, and compassion to those who seek His guidance and protection. Thus, the name Rafaat represents the idea of spiritual and emotional restoration, as well as the idea of being surrounded by Allah's grace and favor. It is a reminder of the belief in the power of prayer, repentance, and perseverance in seeking Allah's mercy and healing for the soul.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Healer, Giver of Good Fortune" symbolizes The one who heals and bestows good fortune. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Rafaat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of healer, giver of good fortune.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Rafaat was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Rafaat carried significant weight in that era.

trends: Classic Islamic name maintaining steady popularity
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Rafaat remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Layla Rafaat in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Rafaat, which means "Healer, Giver of Good Fortune". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
